authority: decision_20261101_r7.md and direct user pixel uncertainty reply

projection.views: training only, inherited calibrated MVS pixel grid
projection.depth: median finite positive confidence-masked MVS depths in window
projection.uncertainty: median per-valid-pixel sigma_M in same window

pixel_uncertainty.query: unproject each valid MVS pixel using its own depth and K/W2C; nearest stage-0 registered patch centre in same unit/prior
pixel_uncertainty.u: nearest patch frozen u only if not replaced and finite
pixel_uncertainty.fallback: median finite original frozen u over same unit/prior; no cross-unit transfer
pixel_uncertainty.reference_only: tested patch frozen u; identical depth/window/vote rule, not used for decisions

output.background: unchanged existing MVS seeds and scope; uncovered pixels use inherited MVS target
output.accuracy: GT within inherited tau of prior surface; unavailable truth stays unavailable; all-keep and all-delete comparisons
